Location that converts
The location platform for digital commerce.
Address Autocomplete, Store Locator, Geocoding and Search APIs trusted by retail and digital-native teams across Europe. Cleaner checkouts. Sharper store search. Better local visibility.
Book a demo

Enterprise customers

Addresses and POIs

Enterprise SLA
Three moments where location decides the sale.
Acquisition, engagement and conversion run on the same location stack.
01 · Acquisition
Local pages that get picked first.
Spatial context, opening hours, routing data and structured signals. Local pages built to rank in search engines and get picked up by AI assistants.
Customer-reported organic uplift on local pages.
02 · Engagement
Store search that finds the right one.
Stock-aware, travel-time-aware product and store search. Click-and-collect, isochrone ranking, mobile-first widgets that scale.
Up to 
+15%
 add-to-cart on location-aware search, customer-reported.
03 · Conversion
Address capture that doesn't break.
One field, building-entrance precision, PAF-grade UK addresses, ROOFTOP precision worldwide. Behind your domain, no resale, no shadow profiles.
Up to 
+35%
 conversion uplift on mobile checkout, customer-reported.
Three building blocks for commerce.
Part of the wider Woosmap platform. REST endpoints, mobile SDKs (iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native). Backed by experts who know your integration and are there when you need it.
 
Address search
Clean, valid addresses captured as customers type. Fewer checkout errors and failed deliveries, higher conversion.
Learn more
 
 
Distance calculations
Real travel times and distances between any points. Accurate delivery zones, fair slot pricing and the nearest store shown first.
Learn more
 
 
Map displays
Fast, on-brand maps on web and mobile. Customers find and reach your stores faster.
Learn more
 
Enterprise location intelligence, built for commerce.
Commerce teams need more than navigation maps. We built the stack for retail and digital-native commerce.
 
Accuracy curated for commerce.
800 million addresses and points of interest, sourced from official providers and curated for retail and digital-native use cases.
 
Your data stays yours.
GDPR-compliant. Woosmap does not use your data or your users' data to power advertising or other products. Your data stays yours.
 
Pricing that holds at scale.
Pay-as-you-go makes costs transparent for builders and POCs. Enterprise makes budgets predictable at scale, with annual planning, budget monitoring, SLA and dedicated CSM.
 
Migration without the rewrite.
Familiar REST patterns, parallel integration and staged rollout. Enterprise migration support, including a dedicated migration manager for qualified scopes.
 
A team you can reach.
Solution engineers who know retail and digital-native integration patterns, in your timezone. Direct support channels for Enterprise customers.
 
Built to scale.
28 billion location calls processed annually. 99.9% Enterprise SLA. Mobile SDKs for iOS, Android, Flutter and React Native. The same stack runs from POC to global rollout.

Woosmap Map API: Elevate Your Mapping Experience
Unlock the full potential of your web and mobile applications using the Woosmap Map API. 
Our JavaScript API, native SDKs and Static Map API let you create customized, interactive or static maps that enhance user experience and deliver valuable insights with minimal coding.
Create a free developer account
Dev Docs
Overview
Customization
Unification
Integration
Automation
Create a Rich Mapping Experience for Your Users
Integrate dynamic, interactive maps or light and fast loading static maps directly into your web pages with the Woosmap Map API, providing users with relevant geographic information effortlessly.
Easily embed and customze interactive maps to meet your specific needs.
Add Stores API overlays and other points of interest (POI) for fast display of thousands of data points at any scale.
Use vector-based graphics to represent complex real-world objects.
Display detailed information for each point of interest (POI) on the map.
Create a free developer account
Dev Docs
 
Improve navigation with interactive vector maps
 
Simplify integration with industry-standard practices
 
Integrate maps everywhere with static maps capabilities
Brand Your Maps with Customizable Styles
Tailor the visual presentation of your maps with the Woosmap Map API to align with your brand’s identity and highlight key elements for your users.
Adjust the appearance of roads, buildings, and points of interest to reflect your brand.
Manage the visibility of various map components to suit specific use cases.
Create unique map designs using tools like Snazzy Maps or Google Maps Style.
Implement custom styles effectively with MapStyleSpec objects.
Choose from predefined styles such as All POIs Visible, Transit By Night, Retro, and Light Grey to enhance user experience.
Create a free developer account
Dev Docs
 
Maps to match brand visual guidelines
 
Highlight key areas and POIs for improved user navigation

Deliver Consistent Map Experiences to Your Users
Create a seamless mapping experience across all devices and customer journey. Enhance interactions between users and your applications with Woosmap's Native SDKs for iOS and Android, and extend your reach to lightweight or image-based channels thanks to the Static Map capabilities.
Utilize Woosmap services effortlessly on JS, iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter.
Ensure visual consistency by delivering customized maps across web, mobile apps, and any platform supporting static images.
Combine multiple Woosmap APIs — Stores, Localities, Distance, Indoor, and more — into a single, unified mapping experience.
Create a free developer account
Dev Docs
 
Boost user engagement with consistent branding of your applications
 
Develop advanced mobile experiences with free maploads on iOS and Android
 
Save time and reduce complexity by leveraging the entire Woosmap platform within a unified framework
Enhance Your Mapping Capabilities
Seamlessly integrate the Woosmap Map API with other services to provide a robust solution for route planning, location details, and more.
Obtain accurate distance, duration, and path details between points.
Access real-time data and timetables for transit routes.
Include pedestrian routes in itineraries for comprehensive directions.
Evaluate and display routes on maps using transit agency data.
Improve mapping accuracy by overlaying indoor maps on the basemap.
Create a free developer account
Dev Docs
 
Save time spent on coding
 
Differentiate your maps from competitors
 
Ease the maintenance of your code over time
Effortlessly Generate Static Maps on Demand
Trigger the generation of map images automatically through simple HTTP calls—ideal for embedding ready-made maps in emails, reports, dashboards, or triggering via backend workflows. The Woosmap Static Maps API accepts essential parameters to produce fully rendered PNG images with minimal integration effort.
Build maps programmatically—no user interaction or manual steps required.
Supports essential parameters like latitude, longitude, zoom, size, markers, and overlays for tailor made image.
Perfect for delivering pre-rendered, branded maps into workflows, notifications, or communications.

FAQs
Which rendering style is implemented in the Map API?
 
Woosmap Map API uses vector rendering. Because vector tiles are not pre-rendered (like raster tiles), they are simple to edit and adapt to fit to your use case. Read more on the 
documentation
.
Can I modify the styling of my map?
 
Yes, you can definitely modify the different layers of the Woosmap map (buildings, roads, forests, water...) with your own style in order to match your brand identity or to highlight some elements or POI depending on your use case.
Our DevRel tells you everything in this 
video
 about how to set up your map with default mode or how to create a personalised one.
Why should I opt for the Woosmap Map instead of other solutions? 
 
The Woosmap Map is a vectorial map that displays your data in a fast and efficient way. The rendering will always be smooth and clear, which makes it a great base to build your application on top of it.
With the Woosmap Map you can easily display your locations such as venues or shops and create your own Store Locator and directly display information about your POI. You can do it by either hosting your datas on Woosmap with Store Search API and Data Management API or by charging directly the data from your client’s servers.
With the Woosmap Map you can also look for places, 
calculate and show itineraries
 and 
draw geometrical forms
. 
Plus, if you’re already using other Woosmap APIs, the best match is Woosmap Map because it was developed on the same geographic database.
Is the Woosmap Map compatible with geolocation APIs that are not from Woosmap? 
 
Yes, at Woosmap we always develop products and services with an “open ecosystem” vision. 
We only make applications that are compatible with other products
. You can use the Woosmap Map as a base and add other geolocation APIs on top of it to associate other features and create your application. 
You can always 
contact
 our team for support!
Which platform is the Woosmap Map compatible with?
 
The Map can be implemented either on your website or in mobile apps. Follow the following 
link to implement the API on your website in Javascript
.
Take benefit of Woosmap Map in your mobile app thanks to our 
Native SDKs
 (iOS and Android) or our 
React Native
 or 
Flutter kit
.
Are the maps displayable in different languages?
 
Absolutely. The map adapts to user’s browser language, labels and names are then displayed accordingly. You can however customise your map for a specific country or region by changing the default language settings.
Get in touch
Let's discuss how you can utilise the Woosmap Platform to drive growth.
